welcome: Welcome to PashuMitra animal health helpline.
language_select: Press 1 for English. Press 2 for Telugu. Press 3 for Hindi. Press 4 for Marathi.
main_menu: Press 1 to talk to a veterinarian. Press 2 to report an animal health problem through automated survey.
main_menu_repeat: Press 1 for veterinarian assistance. Press 2 for automated survey. Press 9 to repeat. Press 0 to go back.
vet_connecting: Connecting you to an available veterinarian. Please stay on the line.
vet_unavailable: No veterinarian is currently available. You can report the animal problem through our automated survey. Your report will be sent to the veterinary and government teams.
vet_no_answer: The veterinarian did not answer. Transferring you to automated survey.
recording_notice: This call may be recorded for veterinary record keeping and quality assurance. Your information will be kept secure.
recording_consent_prompt: Press 1 to consent to call recording. Press 2 to continue without recording.
survey_intro: We will ask you a few short questions about your animal. Answer using your keypad or voice. Press 9 to repeat any question. Press 0 to go back.
q_farmer_name: Please say your name after the beep, or press 1 to skip.
q_species: What is the animal species? Press 1 for Cattle. Press 2 for Buffalo. Press 3 for Goat. Press 4 for Sheep. Press 5 for Poultry. Press 6 for Other.
q_animal_count: How many animals are affected? Enter the number using your keypad, then press hash.
q_breed: Please say the breed of the animal, or press 1 to skip if you don't know.
q_age: What is the age of the animal in years? Enter the number, or press hash to skip.
q_sex: What is the sex of the animal? Press 1 for Female. Press 2 for Male. Press 3 if you don't know.
q_pregnancy: Is the animal pregnant? Press 1 for Yes. Press 2 for No. Press 3 if not applicable.
q_main_problem: What is the main problem? Press 1 for Fever. Press 2 for Not eating. Press 3 for Diarrhea. Press 4 for Breathing difficulty. Press 5 for Skin lesions. Press 6 for Lameness. Press 7 for Other. You may also speak briefly after the beep.
q_symptoms: Please describe the symptoms briefly after the beep, or press hash to continue.
q_duration: For how many days has the animal been sick? Enter the number of days, then press hash.
q_severity: How severe is the condition? Press 1 for Mild. Press 2 for Moderate. Press 3 for Severe. Press 4 for Critical.
q_eating: Is the animal eating normally? Press 1 for Yes. Press 2 for No.
q_drinking: Is the animal drinking water normally? Press 1 for Yes. Press 2 for No.
q_temperature: If you know the animal's temperature, enter it and press hash. Otherwise press hash to skip.
q_vaccination: Has the animal been vaccinated? Press 1 for Yes. Press 2 for No. Press 3 if you don't know.
q_previous_disease: Has this animal had similar disease before? Press 1 for Yes. Press 2 for No.
q_medicines: Have you given any medicine to the animal? Please say the medicine names after the beep, or press hash to skip.
q_location_village: Please say your village name after the beep, or enter it using keypad. Press 9 to repeat.
q_location_district: Please say your district name after the beep. For example, Pune, Nashik, Nagpur.
q_location_state: Please say your state name. Press 1 for Maharashtra. Press 2 for other state.
q_additional: Is there anything else you want to tell about the animal? Please speak after the beep, or press hash to finish.
confirm_answer: You selected {answer}. Press 1 for Yes, 2 for No to correct.
confirm_speech: You said {answer}. Is that correct? Press 1 for Yes, 2 for No.
retry_prompt: I did not understand. Please try again. Press 9 to repeat the question.
timeout_prompt: We did not hear your response. Please try again.
survey_complete: Thank you. Your report has been received. A veterinarian will review it shortly. You will receive a notification. Goodbye.
survey_partial: We have saved the information you provided. A veterinarian will review your partial report. Goodbye.
goodbye: Thank you for calling PashuMitra. Goodbye.
error_generic: We are experiencing technical difficulties. Please try again later. Goodbye.
callback_number_prompt: Your caller number is hidden. Please enter your callback number using keypad, then press hash.
location_link_sms: We have sent a location sharing link to your phone. Please open it to share your exact location if you wish.
dtmf_help: Press 9 to repeat. Press 0 to go back. Press hash to skip.
emergency_escalated: Your report has been marked as high priority and will be reviewed urgently.
